question:
Identify the ANTONYM of the word in brackets.

The athlete's (languid) performance disappointed the fans as well as coaches.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Vigorous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Languid"** refers to lacking energy, enthusiasm, or vitality; it implies being sluggish or weak. (सुस्त, आलसी)

 
 
• **Example:** After working long hours, she felt languid and just wanted to lie on the couch.
 
 
 
• **"Vigorous" **is the antonym of languid. It means full of energy, forceful, strong, and active. (जोशीला, ऊर्जावान)
 
 
• **Example:** The vigorous debate between the candidates showcased their deep knowledge on the subject.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **"Languid"** is **"Vigorous"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Vigorous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Relaxed** (आराम से): Being free from tension or stress; calm and composed.

 
 
• **Example:** He felt relaxed after taking a long vacation by the beach.
 
 
 
• **Listless **(उदासीन): Lacking energy or enthusiasm, similar to languid.
 
 
• **Example:** She became listless after hearing the disappointing news.
 
 
 
• **Lethargic** (सुस्त): Drowsy, sluggish, or lacking energy.
 
 
• **Example:** The hot weather made everyone feel lethargic and unwilling to move.
